item.title: Welcome to WP Plugin Info Card Demo
item.dc:creator: ronalfy
item.content:encoded:
WP Plugin Info Card is the solution for showcasing WordPress plugins and themes.

WP Plugin Info Card lets you showcase WordPress plugins, GitHub repositories, Easy Digital Downloads plugins, and custom (third-party) plugins in a beautiful and customizable showcase using blocks or shortcodes.

Edit This Post

Standard Plugin Cards Using a Slim Card Format

Here are three shortcode cards. Edit this post to see the shortcodes in use.

[wp-pic type="plugin" slug="simple-comment-editing"]
[wp-pic type="plugin" slug="highlight-and-share"]
[wp-pic type="plugin" slug="wp-ajaxify-comments"]

Here are the same three cards that use blocks instead.

Large Card Layout

A large card layout has more detail and is much larger than the slim cards.

WordPress Card Layout

The WordPress layout is a card that mimics the WordPress core embed block for plugins and themes.

Query Plugins Using the Query Block and Shortcode

You can do a query for plugins and display them in a grid. Here's a list of plugins tagged Blocks sorted by installs.

Site Plugins List

List all of the available plugins on your site in one list. This is perfect for giving credit to the plugin authors behind the site.

Screenshots Block and Shortcode

List a plugin in a large card with screenshots and lightbox support. It supports several themes for appearance.

Plugin Badges

Use the plugin badges block and shortcode to showcase .org contributions. This is perfect for team pages and for showcasing your contributions to the WordPress Community.

GitHub Repos

Lastly, you can show off your plugin or theme GitHub repos.

Thank you for viewing the demo.
